verdict.rationale: Warp documents API keys that let the Oz CLI, cloud agents, and self-hosted workers authenticate non-interactively, so it does issue agent-facing credentials. Nothing shows those keys can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. Agent profiles limit what the agent may do, but that is a separate behavior control, not credential scoping. missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permission restrictions, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration of least-privilege credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API keys let the Oz CLI, cloud agents, and self-hosted workers authenticate without human interaction.
